description: Setup profiles for DebloatKit-GUI.ps1 (Profiles tab). A profile is a starting point plus a few yes/no questions; the GUI resolves them to a list of tweak ids and ticks the ones the engine can run. Tweak lists per profile come from optionProfiles in appx-profiles.json (the same four names); this file adds the questions and the defaults. A profile may only contain ids from the catalog that are not never-default and not reduces-security (DebloatKit-GUI.ps1 -SelfTest and tests\Test-Engine.ps1 check that). The engine's preset gate stays authoritative: ids in a preset that is not enabled are listed as 'not enabled in this version', never forced.

questions.hint: Keeps the selection to safe, high-value tweaks and never plans app removal, extra power changes or component cleanup. Update, time sync and telemetry-pipeline tweaks are skipped by the engine on a managed device anyway.
Adds the performance power plan and the per-user Game DVR / app capture switch off. The Xbox apps are not touched (see 'Keep Xbox').
A laptop keeps Fast Startup, hibernate and its power plan; the hibernation file is reduced instead of removed, and no performance power plan is planned.

questions.text: Keep Xbox and the gaming overlay apps?
questions.hint: Only matters when app removal is chosen. No plans the Xbox AppX removal tweak (aggressive preset).
Only matters when app removal is chosen. No plans the Phone Link / Cross Device AppX removal tweak.

Plans the keep-personal AppX profile (keep-work on a work PC). Removed apps have no exact undo: they must be reinstalled from the Store. The GUI never passes -AllowIrreversible and the preset is not enabled in this version, so this is shown as a plan only.

yes.requiresAck: I understand these apps must be reinstalled from the Store (no exact undo)
